FINAL DESIGN: thin entrypoint parses argv[2] then dynamic import('./groups/<group>.js'); Mission Studio/Planning Cognition/adapters load only inside the group that needs them. Command-weight gate: light groups (version/help/status/explain/docs) SKIP the 13-step bootstrap; heavy groups run it inside their module. Benchmark: version/help <100ms, status/explain <300ms cold. Implement BEFORE verb consolidation (restructures dispatch first).

FINAL DESIGN: one shared verb vocabulary across mission+expedition (create->approve->start->finish --disposition complete|archive|cancel; evidence/show/list/report/move/delete explicit). check=validate; check --full absorbs validate --full + verify(no-sub) + govern validation; check --repair=repair. govern=release gate (build+test+audit+proof). verify=signatures only. status absorbs checkpoint; explain=deep; init/--import absorbs discover+migrate. doctor absorbs support verbs. Implement AFTER loader lands.
